decisions.reason: The source also finalizes the wiring-plan deliverable, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The approved BOM remains valid unchanged; the source excludes an additional purchasing list rather than changing the existing approved BOM state.
The milestone-deliverable clarification does not change the selected power source, electrical capacities, controllers, or reserve margin.
Finalizing the layout and wiring-plan deliverables does not alter the device's reliability or electrical-load requirements.
The source does not change any structural-stability, vibration-resistance, base, or footing behavior.
The statement that no additional components are needed at this stage does not change the established off-the-shelf and custom-fabrication strategies.
The deliverable clarification does not modify any bowl, whisk, or spout cleaning requirement.
Finalizing the system layout does not itself change the required bowl-removal clearance or event swapping workflow.
The source does not alter the quick, simple, preferably tool-free whisk-removal behavior.
The milestone clarification does not change the selected whisk head, material, dimensions, compatibility, or positioning criterion.
